_readme: Plain-language glosses for technical terms, used on the public view only. /corporate keeps the full engineering vocabulary. Keep each gloss to one sentence a homeowner would understand.

terms.gloss: Large buildings are cooled by water chilled in a central plant room and piped to every floor, instead of one unit per room.
One outdoor unit running many indoor units, each set to its own temperature. Common in offices and shops.
A single hidden unit that cools several rooms through ducts in the ceiling, so you see only the grilles.
Regular scheduled servicing that cleans the unit and catches small faults before they become breakdowns.
Rooftop rods and cabling that carry a lightning strike safely into the ground instead of through your building.
A safe path for stray electricity, so a fault trips the breaker rather than shocking someone or starting a fire.
